headline: LT Foods Shares Rise 8% After Acquiring US Brand Maya Kaimal for $5.8 Million
summary: LT Foods shares surged 8% to Rs 453 after its subsidiary LT Foods Americas acquired US packaged foods company MK Foods Holdings, owner of Maya Kaimal, for $5.8 million.
why: LT Foods is an Indian consumer food manufacturer best known for its specialty rice and packaged food brands.

impacts.name: LT Foods
impacts.why: Acquisition of US-based Maya Kaimal brand boosted stock sentiment and pushed shares 8% higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strategic expansion into US Indian-inspired packaged foods lifted investor demand for LT Foods shares.
